hypothesis: One full-parameter response-only PRESTO English SFT stage, with a bounded train-only replay of revision, disfluency, contextual, ABSTAIN, and CONFIRM rows, will add useful contextual action compilation while preserving strict Action IR syntax.
decision: Keep this stage as a broader candidate only if derived PRESTO development exact match reaches 0.70, ABSTAIN F1 reaches 0.80, schema validity reaches 0.95, false CALL on ABSTAIN/CONFIRM gates is at most 0.01, and represented revision/disfluency buckets are no more than 0.10 below the represented no-phenomenon bucket. This is not a larger-model or blind-test claim.

dataset.official_test_policy: member remains unopened, unparsed, and unmaterialized; central-directory metadata and whole-archive hash only

train_view.selection: lowest SHA-256(seed:category:source-example-id) among eligible official-train rows

exact_prompt_target_dev_exclusion.identity: SHA-256(canonical JSON object with exact prompt and exact target strings)
exact_prompt_target_dev_exclusion.policy: exclude every official-train row whose identity occurs in official development before focus selection; correctness-blind and record all excluded train IDs

evaluation.checkpoint_policy: latest checkpoint whose development response-only loss improves the previously selected loss by more than the frozen 0.001 minimum delta; final checkpoint if none qualifies
evaluation.generation_max_new_tokens: minimum of 384 and audited development target maximum plus 24
evaluation.false_call_on_gate_definition: any parse-valid top-level CALL on an ABSTAIN or CONFIRM gold row, including a CALL whose tool or payload is schema-invalid and policy-blocked

limitations: PRESTO official development has known template overlap with training and is not a blind breakthrough set.
The Action IR safety mapping is derived and must not be reported as native PRESTO semantic-parse exact match.
This single development-selected stage does not establish robustness across seeds or preservation of Mobile Actions behavior.
PRESTO supplies no CLARIFY supervision and does not by itself complete the product safety distribution.
